title: Counter-Tune the Fork
prompt: Match the repeating cutter pulse before the cold loop overheats.
success_message: The cutter, suit ground, and operator loop lock into phase.
failure_hint: The signals beat against each other and the cold loop climbs. Adjust the sweep, coolant, and ground phase.

title: Harmonic Choir Lock
prompt: Hold Nova's heartbeat against the Chorus without flattening the other voices.
success_message: The Chorus keeps its separate voices and turns with Nova instead of against her.
failure_hint: The note is too solitary. Keep the heartbeat steady, but leave room for the others.

title: Calibrate Bioluminescent Prism
prompt: Refract the glowing grotto frequencies across the ancient crystal lattice.
success_message: The crystal lattice illuminates with resonant green light, revealing an ancient focus component.
failure_hint: The prism beam flickers out of phase. Balance the lux level, angle, and crystal frequency.

title: Synchronize Chrono Coils
prompt: Align the tachyon oscillation loop before the archive crystals decohere.
success_message: The tachyon loop locks into crystalline harmony, expelling an overclocked core.
failure_hint: Temporal jitter is distorting the loop. Dampen the flux and steady the pitch.

title: Balance Magma Conduit
prompt: Regulate the smelting conduit pressure to unlock the ancient cooling cradle.
success_message: Pressure stabilizes with a heavy hiss, releasing a pristine thermal armor plate.
failure_hint: Conduit pressure is spiking dangerously. Bleed the excess heat and reseal the valve.

title: Phase-Lock Graviton Well
prompt: Neutralize gravitational shearing forces to stabilize the ancient subterranean vault.
success_message: Gravity normalizes with a deep hum, unsealing the graviton inertia matrix.
failure_hint: The gravity well pulls violently off-axis. Stabilize the mass dampener and spin frequency.
